# The TextEditor+ icon

The app icon (a badger in glasses and a suit, writing with a quill, with the
"TextEditor+" name below it, on a blue rounded square) was generated by
**Nano Banana**, the image model in Google's Gemini, for Sanjeeva Wijeyesakere,
from this prompt:

> I have developed a text editor called TextEditor+. It's on github
> (https://github.com/swijeyes/TextEditor-) and I need an app icon. Generate one
> that's got a cute animal theme but still retains a professional look for a text
> editor

The prompt names no artist, art style, brand or existing character.

## Files made from it

| File | How |
|---|---|
| `../../icon/texteditor_icon.png` | The generated image (406 × 420 px) |
| `texteditor_icon-source.png` | A copy of it |
| `icon.icns` (macOS) | Padded to the macOS 1024 px icon grid (824 px tile) and scaled to each size; the two largest sizes are upscaled |
| `icon.ico` (Windows), `icon.png` (window icon) | Scaled from the same image |
| User manual title page | The same image |

All of these are made by `../tools/make-icons.sh`. It first cuts off the
thin lighter bevel around the generated image's rounded square (it showed as a
grey border), by shrinking the square's mask by 5 px.
